notes: analog dates restricted to 1988-01-01..2026-07-24 (in-sample); today's state is OOS (query only)
forward windows may extend past the freeze; flagged per episode (fwd12m_crosses_freeze)
gold63 never computed from monthly-interpolated gold (pre 2000-09 -> NaN)
F2 = QLD vt 0.30 + 15% gold_phys + IEF; F3 = TQQQ vt 0.20 + 15% gold_phys + IEF; common.py mechanics
strategy state = target weights at the last Friday mark <= t (held from t+1)
whipsaws_6m = weekly re-entries reversed within the next 126 trading days

R1.desc: brief spec: DD from ATH in [-20%,-8%], cluster age 10-40d, vol20>25%, risk-off; first hit

R1a.desc: R1 filter + cluster age within +-5d of today's (still below EMA at today's age); date in each episode with age closest to today's

R2.desc: R1 with DD from 52-week high instead of ATH; first hit

R3.desc: R2 + 10y yield up >25bp over 126d (rates-rising sell-off); first hit

R4.desc: tight band: DD52 [-17%,-10%], cluster age 15-35d, vol20>28%, risk-off; first hit

R5.desc: gold stress: risk-off, DD52 <= -8%, gold_phys 63d <= -8% (daily-real gold only, 2000-12+); first hit

K1.desc: kNN price state: dd52, log(1+cluster age), log vol20, er20

K2.desc: kNN price + macro: K1 + 10y level, 10y 126d chg, curve, dxy 126d chg, log VIX (1990+)

K3.desc: kNN K2 + gold 63d return (dates >= 2000-12, daily-real gold only)

union.desc: union of all analog sets, de-duplicated (earliest date per 60-day cluster)

B1_riskoff_state_matched.desc: block 1 starts on a risk-off day; blocks 2-4 start on days whose state matches the state at the end of the previous block (keeps regime persistence)

B2_riskoff_then_uniform.desc: block 1 starts on a risk-off day; blocks 2-4 uniform

B3_likenow_state_matched.desc: block 1 starts on an R2-like day (risk-off, DD52 8-20%, age 10-40, vol>25%); state-matched continuation

B4_riskoff_ratesup_state_matched.desc: block 1 starts on a risk-off day with the 10y yield up >25bp over 126d (bond off-leg under pressure, like now); state-matched continuation
